about.title: About Me
about.description1: I'm a software engineer with experience building enterprise full-stack solutions and integrating AI in production. I specialize in scalable architectures with .NET, Angular, and React, on Azure and Google Cloud Platform.
about.description2: My approach combines technical excellence with user empathy, ensuring that solutions are not only technically sound but also intuitive and accessible for all users.
about.description3: I'm constantly learning and exploring new technologies, with a focus on performance optimization, component architecture, and design systems.

descriptions.haceb: Software Engineer at Industrias Haceb S.A., focused on the design, development, and implementation of scalable technology solutions for enterprise environments. Full-stack development with .NET, Angular, and SQL Server, alongside cloud services on Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Involved in requirements analysis, API construction, system integration, internal process optimization, and business-oriented application development, applying best practices in performance, security, and maintainability under agile methodologies.
descriptions.eafit: Developed conversational AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio for automated student support, designing 4 conversation flows with optimized business logic and prompts. Built a full-stack web portal with Angular 20 (zoneless, Signals), TypeScript, RxJS, and .NET Core. Integrated multiple AI services: Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, and Copilot Studio with BotFramework-WebChat. Implemented enterprise telemetry with Azure Application Insights, ensuring GDPR compliance, chat state persistence system with localStorage, and corporate authentication with MSAL. Configured Azure infrastructure (App Services, Application Insights, Bot Services).
descriptions.intern: Designed and maintained web and desktop applications in C# and ASP .NET, improving functionality and support processes. Conducted database performance tuning and optimization for Microsoft SQL Server, reducing query times by up to 30%. Provided technical support and training to end users, ensuring smooth adoption of software solutions.
descriptions.fullstack: Participated in the development and implementation of internal modules for inventory management and lighting control systems, using ASP.NET Core, C#, and SQL Server. Built dynamic web interfaces with Angular and TypeScript, focused on optimizing user experience. Integrated REST services and JWT authentication to ensure security in platform access processes. Collaborated in migrating legacy systems to more scalable architectures, applying SOLID principles and Clean Architecture best practices.
descriptions.freelance: As a versatile freelance full-stack developer and digital entrepreneur, I have architected and delivered e-commerce platforms and web applications—selling digital products and consulting services—using PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter) and Python (Flask), with responsive front-ends built in HTML5, Tailwind CSS, and Vue.js/React; I've deployed and managed these solutions on Google Cloud Platform and cPanel hosting, automated CI/CD with Azure Pipelines and GitHub Actions, and implemented Python-based ETL and analytics scripts to ensure sub-200 ms response times, 99.5 %+ uptime, and seamless, data-driven user experiences.
descriptions.analyst: Designed and maintained web and desktop applications in C# and ASP .NET, improving functionality and support processes. Conducted database performance tuning and optimization for Microsoft SQL Server, reducing query times by up to 30%. Provided technical support and training to end users, ensuring smooth adoption of software solutions.
descriptions.junior: Developed cryptocurrency point-of-sale applications in C# and ASP .NET, integrating hardware components and payment gateways. Collaborated on API design and implementation for secure transaction processing. Participated in code reviews and established unit testing practices to improve code quality.
descriptions.trainee: Supported AS/400 system maintenance and performance monitoring for pricing and after-sales campaigns. Assisted in data management and reporting, using DB2 queries to inform business decisions. Coordinated with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot technical issues and optimize operational workflows.

ai.title: How an agent I built works
ai.lede: At EAFIT I built a Copilot Studio agent for Microsoft Teams that advises students on certificates: it checks the status of their request, hands over the download code when it is ready and validates whether they appear on the Sapiencia lists. All of it measured with Application Insights.
ai.question: Hi, what is the status of my transcript certificate?
ai.answer: Your request is approved: download it with code CERT-8F3K-2Q. I also confirmed you are on the current Sapiencia list.
